final: WITH store_counts AS (SELECT store_id, COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM customer GROUP BY store_id) SELECT store_id, customer_count, 1.0 * customer_count / SUM(customer_count) OVER () AS share_of_total, 1.0 * customer_count / AVG(customer_count) OVER () AS relative_to_average FROM store_counts ORDER BY store_id
